title: Cruel
landscapeBanner: Rotate to landscape for an easier view of the 12-column tableau
playing: Build down by suit on the tableau and stack each suit to the foundation
stalemate: Stalemate — use Shift to rebuild the tableau

frontendHint.moveToFoundation: A card is ready to move to the foundation
frontendHint.shiftRecommended: Try Shift to rebuild the tableau and create new moves

tutorial.foundation: The 4 Aces are auto-placed here at deal time. Build each suit up A→K.
tutorial.tableau: 12 columns of 4 face-up cards. Only the top card of a column can move, and only onto a same-suit card one rank higher.
tutorial.shift: When you get stuck, Shift gathers the remaining tableau cards and redeals them into 12×4 left-aligned columns.
tutorial.controls: Hint, auto-complete, undo, and give-up controls.

help: m <from> <to>  Move top card between tableau columns
m <from> f     Move tableau top card to foundation
